description: This Java class 'SecureFtpClient' implements an FTP client interface with methods for connecting, copying files, listing directory contents, setting transfer mode, and closing the connection. However, method implementations are currently placeholders.

classes.name: SecureFtpClient
classes.description: A Java class implementing an FTP client with methods to connect, transfer files, list directories, configure transfer modes, and close connections. Currently, methods are unimplemented.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an FTP connection to the specified host with provided credentials and parameters. Currently not implemented.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Uploads a file to the specified path on the FTP server using an InputStream.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists files in the specified directory path on the FTP server. Currently returns null.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Configures whether to use binary transfer mode.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Configures whether to use passive mode for FTP transfers.
